messages:
alice: quick sync — University of Cascadia (research lab, non-profit) asked for an "edu" pricing tier: deep discount, monthly microcommit option, and a lightweight verification flow. they want conference bursting. what are launch criteria and guardrails?

ben: finance: need leakage controls. discounts ok but require eligibility checks + termination clause. recommend 40–60% off for verified orgs, no resale, and invoice credit for pilot to simplify auditing.

carla: product: agree on verification + non-commercial clause. propose initial constraints: hosted-only, no Dedicated, default monthly token cap 5M with burst cap 10M throttled, pilot 3 months.

sara: sales: keep signup simple. gov docs = dead weight. prefer email verification + manual review for >$5k/mo. pilot offer suggestion: 3mo 75% credit up to $2k, then conversion path.

mike: eng ops: bursting fine if hosted API only. we can do per-tenant prefix caching + rate buckets. need SLOs for pilot (95th pct latency target) and a burst throttle. implement X-Burst-Allowed header for approved orgs.

ben: billing: need invoice flag and audit trail for discounted accounts. create billing ticket and set pilot credit accounting.

billing-bot: created ticket BILL-1245 for "edu pricing flag + invoice label" — assigned to @ben and @mike.

carla: draft launch criteria:
- eligibility: verified .edu or registered non-profit (auto-check + manual fallback)
- guardrails: monthly token cap 5,000,000, burst cap 10,000,000 with enforced throttle
- product: hosted API only, no Dedicated/private deployments
- ops: 3-month pilot, monitor latency and cost delta
- metrics: conversion >=15% or 60% retention at month 6 to consider permanent

alice: +1. open Q: invoice credit vs percent-off for billing — which is easier to start?

ben: invoice credit easiest to audit; percent-off simpler later. start with credit for pilot.

sara: partner (lab admin) can request conference bursts via a short form; approval SLA 24–48h.

mike: ops tasks: prototype burst-token bucket, add X-Burst-Allowed header toggle, dashboard metric for burst usage.

carla: legal: need non-commercial terms and data retention opt-in for edu tier. will request copy.

alice: next steps:
- ben/billing: implement pilot billing flag + credit flow (BILL-1245)
- mike: prototype burst-token header + throttle
- sara: run pilot outreach + signup doc
- carla: finalize product spec + launch checklist

sara: will draft outreach email and signup form. ping me for copy review.

ben: I'll draft pilot credit terms and loop in legal.

mike: will open a PR for the X-Burst-Allowed header and add monitoring.

alice: target pilot launch in 3 weeks pending legal & billing ticket. :rocket:

mike: :thumbsup: 

sara: :raised_hands: 

carla: added short spec link: https://redwood.internal/docs/edu-tier-proposal — comments welcome.

alice: tagging follow-ups in weekly roadmap review. closing thread; will post updates when billing ticket is live.
